name: Nur Jahan
role: Padshah Begum of the Mughal Empire
contribution: The twentieth wife and chief consort of the Mughal emperor Jahangir.
legacy: Wielding a level of power and influence unprecedented for a Mughal empress, she was granted honours and privileges never enjoyed by any of her predecessors or successors, such as having coinage struck in her name.

checks.lead: Nur Jahan (Persian: نورجهان, lit. 'Light of the World'; 31 May 1577 – 18 December 1645), born Mehr-un-Nissa, was the twentieth wife and chief consort of the Mughal emperor Jahangir.
